 <div>
 <h5 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-800">B.Tech (Computer Science & Engineering)</h5>
 <p class="text-sm text-gray-600 mt-1">B.Tech CSE is a four-year undergraduate program designed to build strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities for modern computing environments.  </div>

 <div class="flex gap-4"> <img decoding="async" src="https://admin.bbdu.ac.in/siteadmin//wp-content/uploads/2025/01/bachelors-degree.png" class="w-16 h-16 object-contain" alt="BCA DS AI">
 <div>
 <h5 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-800">B. Tech (Computer Science & Engineering)-Artificial Intelligence</h5>
 <p class="text-sm text-gray-600 mt-1">B.Tech (CSE) – Artificial Intelligence is designed to prepare students with core computer science skills along with specialized knowledge in artificial intelligence technologies. The program focuses on machine learning, deep learning, data analytics, natural language processing, and intelligent systems. Through hands-on projects and practical exposure, students learn to design AI-driven solutions for real-world applications, preparing them for emerging roles in AI development, research, and advanced technology domains.</p>
 </div>
 </div>
 </a> </div>

<!-- BCA Cyber Security -->

 <div>
 <h5 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-800">B. Tech (Computer Science & Engineering)-Cloud Computing and Machine Learning in collaboration with IBM</h5>
 <p class="text-sm text-gray-600 mt-1">This four-year undergraduate program integrates core computer science education with specialized training in cloud computing and machine learning, aligned with industry practices.  </div>
 </div>
 </a> </div>

 <div>
 <h5 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-800">B. Tech (Computer Science & Engineering) – Artificial Intelligence & Blockchain with IBM</h5>
 <p class="text-sm text-gray-600 mt-1">B.Tech(CSE)- Artificial Intelligence & Blockchain, offered in collaboration with IBM, is a future-focused program that combines intelligent systems with secure and decentralized technologies.  <h5 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-800">B.Tech. (CSE- Generative Artificial Intelligence) with HCL GUVI Collaboration</h5>
 <p class="text-sm text-gray-600 mt-1">B.Tech in Generative Artificial Intelligence (Gen AI) is a futuristic undergraduate program designed to prepare students with strong foundations in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data science, with a specialized focus on generative AI models. sqlite3 -readonly -header -column \""'$db" "with recursive tree(id,slug,name,parent_id,breadcrumb) as (select id,slug,name,parent_id,name from career_nodes where parent_id is null union all select c.id,c.slug,c.name,c.parent_id,t.breadcrumb || '"' > ' || c.name from career_nodes c join tree t on c.parent_id=t.id) select id as career_node_id,slug as career_node_slug,breadcrumb from tree where lower(breadcrumb) like '%computer%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%engineer%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%dental%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%law%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%management%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%hotel%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%pharmacy%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%physio%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%mathemat%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%journal%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%education%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%architecture%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%interior%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%agricultur%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%psycholog%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%language%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%data science%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%chemistry%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%physics%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%biology%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%english%' order by id;\" | sed -n '1,280p'"
